scripts.d1:chunks:local: wrangler d1 execute never-again-db --local --command "SELECT imports.id AS import_id, COUNT(chunks.id) AS chunk_count, SUM(chunks.char_count) AS total_chars FROM imports LEFT JOIN chunks ON chunks.import_id = imports.id GROUP BY imports.id ORDER BY imports.created_at DESC;"
scripts.d1:imports:local: wrangler d1 execute never-again-db --local --command "SELECT projects.name, imports.status AS import_status, imports.redacted_secret_count, imports.normalized_r2_key, jobs.status AS job_status, jobs.progress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chunks WHERE chunks.import_id = imports.id) AS chunk_count FROM imports JOIN projects ON projects.id = imports.project_id JOIN jobs ON jobs.import_id = imports.id ORDER BY imports.created_at DESC;"
scripts.d1:users:local: wrangler d1 execute never-again-db --local --command "SELECT id, email, assistant_status, backboard_assistant_id FROM users;"
